svg.title: Get the cache key right
svg.text: Exact caches changed no answer; a missing part of the key did.
+ re-check the user may still read every cited source
maria (a manager) asks; alice asks it too
A SEMANTIC CACHE, DECIDED IN ADVANCE
serve a past answer if cosine ≥ 0.89: the lowest with no dev answer worse
“If I give money to a charity, will Acme match it?”
nothing answers it; the pipeline refuses, the cache served an answer
value −2 at cost 2: not adopted; similar isn't the same
